name: Samsung First Responder Discount
description: Exclusive extra savings (up to 30% on select products) for verified first responders
fullDescription: Samsung's First Responders Offer Program gives verified first responders exclusive extra savings on phones, tablets, computers, TVs, and appliances, with ID.me verification.
whatTheyOffer:
- Exclusive extra discounts on top of current Samsung deals (amounts vary by product, from about 5% up to 30%)
- Covers Galaxy phones, tablets, laptops, watches, and earbuds
- Offers on TVs, monitors, and home appliances
- Available to verified first responders
howToGetIt:
1. Go to Samsung's First Responders Offer Program page
2. Sign in or create a Samsung account
3. Verify your first responder status through ID.me
4. Exclusive prices show on eligible products after verification
keywords: Samsung, first responder, firefighter, police, EMT, 30% off, Galaxy, phone, tablet, TV
